body:
Raised 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles) by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. PR #1031 merge `90f04d30cf773b5be538bc3d85d4d9051768deef`, reviewed head `faf92a49d1c6203a1b09c4512fe89b6b559b09e1`; closed producing issue #417. An additive dated provenance erratum only, maximum one PR.

The retained `source/NSI-EKATTE-export-20261005.zip` contains distinct per-member vintages. Its municipality member `ek_obst.json` final metadata row states data as of `12/12/2023`, export `05/10/2026 03:00`; its district member `ek_obl.json` states data as of `05/10/2015`, export `05/10/2026 03:28`. These mean 12 December 2023 and 5 October 2015 respectively, with separate 5 October 2026 export timestamps. The zip's single download/export date does not establish one contemporaneous municipality/district snapshot.

The original README presents the combined municipality/district roster as current and describes the archive generically as register data current as of 2023-12-12. The evidence manifest's NSI source vintage repeats one 2023 reference date; provenance records one data-current-as-of date. The actual crosswalk uses `ek_obl.json` to choose parent districts by English name, yet neither private per-subject output nor aggregate summary records the district member's 2015 date. It therefore leaves a 2019 source / 2023 municipality / 2015 district comparison looking like one current dated register. Parent-ID-to-official-code linkage and current legal parent boundaries are separately unverified and must remain explicit.

Reproduce read-only from exact merge and zip SHA256 `6d848e467493f4d6ec6c1c9081bf51266ad888dc8f232c3d1fd2b0a265ace77d`, 413,854 bytes: inspect the full zip directory (12 members, 4,712,618 decoded bytes), wholly read `ek_obst.json` (105,644 bytes) and `ek_obl.json` (11,290 bytes), parse each last row, compare the two as-of/export fields with README, source/nsi-ekatte-provenance.json and evidence-quality.json. Every object is below 32 MiB; the complete reproduction phase including all 14 packet files, three whole baseline inputs, all decoded members and 8 MiB reserve is 39,308,369 bytes. Do not stream/partition or substitute extracted samples for the complete archive/table verification.

Actual original runner executed twice in an isolated sparse detached review slot under Python 3.12.14, redirecting only three exact generated output destinations to fresh private files. Scoped CSV 94,358 bytes SHA256 `8e16f596cc7805d8841a77d40ef202efe7c34f60acbaa5d6c66d19cd0a61a6c9`; full-source CSV 61,666 bytes `9bf598322c17f5cbf0be86e859bb126533e6e8685f0748df047c391ed459eb94`; summary 2,539 bytes `a915b4478bcd822bae51576c16c0a65f5a136157c6a1ad6d1a5369b21e34a928`. Two-run hashes agree; all originals unchanged. Independent whole-register/name/parent checks verify all 213 subjects, 209 normalized exact names/four documented aliases, 212 scoped unique municipality codes, all 265 source records/264 unique municipality codes, the two SFO47 Zlatitsa candidates and missing PAZ39 Sarnitsa. The historical lexical result is correct against these retained tables; no wrong name/code, polygon, original source hash or archive data is alleged.

Expected and success criteria:

- Preserve the exact original archive/source/metadata/issue/claim/code/README/manifest and all stable 213 IDs. Write only an additive erratum under the new owned prefix below; full national tables are read-only contexts, not additional native subjects. Do not distribute row-level joined/derived NSI data beyond the original packet's local-output policy.
- Read the complete original archive and each consumed complete member; retain archive/member identities and record each actual member-specific reference date and export timestamp. Parse day/month/year unambiguously and preserve unknown/absent dates as unknown. A synthetic member with a different metadata date must be reported or rejected honestly, never collapsed into the municipality date.
- Correct the provenance interpretation: the existing crosswalk demonstrates correspondence between named source polygons and register members of different dates. Record municipality and district dates separately in the additive findings and any allowed local per-subject/summary results; qualify claims of current parent membership and retain the lack of an Atlas-parent-ID/code crosswalk. A future genuinely current district source would need independent dated/rights evidence, not a 2026 export timestamp.
- Reproduce the unchanged historical roster results twice; bind immutable whole code/input/member/scope/output identities and meaningful per-table date controls; independently review the exact-head provenance/method and all original preservation checks. Keep code/name matching distinct from dated legal parent or polygon identity.

Readiness: #417 is closed and canonical author reservation released. All 17 complete baseline/packet objects are available under the true commits below; complete open/closed issue pagination and open PR/body checks found no duplicate per-member date task or owner of this prefix. This needs no new institutional download or license adjudication; it corrects interpretation of retained metadata. No worker implementation reservation is taken.

#1030 already owns the separate two-ID Zlatitsa/Sarnitsa lawful-source/polygon/entity restoration, and its original scope and blocked readiness remain intact. It does not own the 213-subject district-vintage provenance correction. Current primary administrative/rights notices and authoritative polygon evidence remain unavailable to this GitHub-only audit, so #1031's overall verification remains Incomplete. No implied institutional authenticity, redistribution grant, geometry/hierarchy replacement, geography approval, publication/import, merge or deployment follows from this erratum. Audit any corrective PR separately.
